page_title: NOT 2-2 WOL | Nottingham Forest v Wolves 13/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' The referee awards a corner and Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes over to take it.
90+7' Divock Origi (Nottingham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Now Nottingham have a corner.
90+5' Murillo (Nottingham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nuno Tavares (Nottingham) replacing Ola Aina.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rodrigo Ribeiro (Nottingham) for Danilo.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nathan Fraser (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Pablo Sarabia.
88' Gary O'Neil has decided to make a change. Tawanda Chirewa (Wolves) replaces Nelson Semedo.
87' Danilo (Nottingham) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
87' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
87' The corner from Danilo (Nottingham) is cleared away by the defence.
86' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

85' Neco Williams (Nottingham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nottingham.
84' Divock Origi (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
81' Neco Williams (Nottingham) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the bottom right corner, but Jose Sa was alert and made an astonishing save!
80' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
77' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
76' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Matheus Cunha is replaced by Boubacar Traore (Wolves).
76' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) plays a lovely through ball to Callum Hudson-Odoi, but he can't beat Jose Sa and loses the ball.
74' Dangerous play by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham). Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. Wolves will take a free kick near the side line.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Divock Origi (Nottingham) will replace Giovanni Reyna.
70' Neco Williams (Nottingham) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Wolves are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
67' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
66' Substitution. Ryan Yates did his best and is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
65' Danilo (Nottingham) launches a cross from the corner, but Jose Sa is alert to thwart the effort.
64' Craig Pawson sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
64' The Wolves players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
62' 2 - 2 Goal 2:2! Matheus Cunha (Wolves) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
62' Max Kilman (Wolves) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
62' The ball goes out for a corner. Wolves can continue in their attacking effort.
62' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
59' Gary O'Neil has decided to substitute Matt Doherty and he is replaced by Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves).
59' A substitution has been made. Joao Gomes goes off and Hugo Bueno (Wolves) comes on.
58' 2 - 1 Goal! Danilo (Nottingham) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
56' Craig Pawson couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Joao Gomes (Wolves) and blew his whistle. Nottingham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
56' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes.
53' The free kick is delivered by Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joao Gomes (Wolves) was quite harsh and Craig Pawson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

50' The game is interrupted. Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. That's a free kick to Wolves.
48' Craig Pawson blows his whistle as Chris Wood (Nottingham) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Free kick. Wolves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
46' Referee Craig Pawson blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Craig Pawson blows for a foul. Nottingham have been awarded a free kick.
45+2' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) receives a yellow card for infringement.
45+2' 1 - 1 Gooal! Giovanni Reyna takes over corner duties. Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 1:1.
45+1' Nottingham get a corner.
45+1' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Nottingham will take a corner.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Nottingham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Danilo (Nottingham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nottingham are going to take it.
43' Ola Aina (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee blows his whistle, Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.

41' 0 - 1 Matheus Cunha (Wolves) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Matz Sels is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top right corner. The score is 0:1.
40' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Nottingham have a free kick.
39' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
38' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Craig Pawson blows his whistle for a foul. Nottingham win a free kick.
37' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Neco Williams (Nottingham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
35' Toti (Wolves) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
33' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Craig Pawson saw the whole situation. A free kick is awarded to Nottingham.
30' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
29' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) makes a strong challenge and Craig Pawson blows for a foul. Wolves are awarded a free kick.
27' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
27' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but Matz Sels comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
25' Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
20' Chris Wood (Nottingham) picks up a long through ball, but Jose Sa deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
17' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
17' Giovanni Reyna (Nottingham) is about to take a corner kick.
16' Ola Aina (Nottingham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Nottingham earn a corner.
13' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa was alert and the score remains the same.
12' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
10' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
8' Neco Williams (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
7' Danilo (Nottingham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jose Sa is well positioned and punches the ball away.

6' That's unlucky! Ryan Yates (Nottingham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Nottingham have a corner.

4' Chris Wood (Nottingham) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. Chris Wood (Nottingham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
3' A lofted cross from Neco Williams (Nottingham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
2' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
